description: This file defines the class BuzzLikeOnCommentDecorator, which is a decorator for the BuzzLikeOnComment entity, providing methods to associate employees and comments, and retrieve formatted timestamps for when a comment was liked.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnCommentDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for BuzzLikeOnComment entity, providing methods to set references to Employee and BuzzComment entities and retrieve formatted liked timestamps.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Protected getter for the BuzzLikeOnComment instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee reference on the BuzzLikeOnComment entity based on employee number.

methods.name: setCommentByCommentId
methods.description: Sets the BuzzComment reference on the BuzzLikeOnComment entity based on comment ID.

methods.name: getLikedAtDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the comment was liked, formatted as a string.

methods.name: getLikedAtTime
methods.description: Returns the time when the comment was liked, formatted as a string.
